::: {#exr-badge-check}
#### When is the door locked?

A door opens when the badge is valid, the PIN is correct, and it is a weekday.
Let $B$ be "the badge is valid", $N$ be "the PIN is correct" and $W$ be "it is a weekday",
so the door stays locked when $\neg (B \land N \land W)$ is true.

Describe when the door stays locked
with a sentence that puts "not" only in front of $B$, $N$ or $W$,
never in front of a compound proposition.

:::
